items.title: The pronoun moves before the general particle
items.caption: The past particle comes before the pronoun. With the general particle, the pronoun comes first and the particle takes the form *te*.

items.title: A habit and an event under way
items.caption: The general particle says what holds as a rule. The happening-now particle marks the event under way at the moment of speaking.

items.title: Sort what holds generally and what is under way
items.intro: Place each complete printed sentence under the time view it expresses.

items.why: The general particle presents a lasting quality.

items.sm: E alu le pasi i le nuʻu.
items.en: The bus goes to the village.
items.why: The general particle presents the trip as a standing habit.
The happening-now particle marks the dancing as under way.
